items.title: JPMorgan, Microsoft, United, FAA service outages: What exactly is going on?
items.summary:
JPMorgan (JPM), Bank of America (BAC), Wells Fargo (WFC), United Airlines (UAL), Microsoft (MSFT), and the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) all experienced system outages recently.

"The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss the tech-related shortcomings that are contributing to these consumer-facing outages.

items.title: As tech crashes mount, how can banks respond?
items.summary: JPMorganChase's outage on Monday came amid glitches impacting air travel and Microsoft. Technology experts say it's time to brush up on public communication skills and get ready for political pressure.

items.title: United Airlines Had a “Widespread System Outage,” 3 Days After the FAA Ground Stop
items.summary: Planes sat at the gate with perfectly good engines, held back by a missing number pilots cannot take off without. With Thanksgiving days away, United's second meltdown in a week raises a pointed question about its tech-first pitch.

items.title: Nvidia's "Valuation Sanity Check", tech software debacles, and Anthropic IPO preview
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down some of the biggest movers in today's tech trade, including a look at Nvidia and its valuation, and why some analysts see that valuation as "draconian". Plus, a closer look at some of the recent tech debacles and outages and whether these trends will continue in the future.

Sozzi also speaks to Kevin O'Leary about the state of the tech market, including the Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) IPO and the rumors about Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.
